create_lasr_processor: create a LasrProcessor instance from a feature_extractor and tokenizer for speech recognition
call_lasr_processor_audio_only: call the LasrProcessor with audio input to extract feature inputs without text labels
call_lasr_processor_with_text: call the LasrProcessor with audio and text inputs to produce feature inputs with labels for training
set_sampling_rate_lasr: set the sampling rate parameter when calling the LasrProcessor to validate audio sample rate
get_model_input_names: get the model input names from the LasrProcessor combining feature extractor names with labels
